packages.name: Basic Listing
packages.description: Your company name, city and phone in the state directory of your choice. If you have a website, we link to it free.

packages.name: Make My Listing Bold
packages.description: Upgrades your listing to bold type so it stands out from the plain listings around it.

packages.name: Expand My Listing (bold with green background)
packages.description: Your listing in bold with a green background — the most eye-catching spot in the company table.

packages.name: Single State Bold Listing
packages.description: A bold listing in the state of your choice, with your city bolded too. Free link to your website.

packages.name: 4 State Bold Listing
packages.description: A bold listing in the four states of your choice, cities bolded. Free link to your website.

packages.name: Single State Super Listing
packages.description: A larger listing in the Super Listings section of the state of your choice, linked to your website.

packages.name: 4 State Super Listing
packages.description: The Super Listing in the four states of your choice.

packages.name: Single State Banner Ad
packages.description: A full-colour ad, any colours you choose, in the State Listings section near the top of the state page. Linked to your website.

packages.name: 4 State Banner Ad
packages.description: The full-colour banner ad in the four states of your choice.

packages.name: 1 City Hotel Listing
packages.description: A 4-line highlighted listing for your hotel, placed right among the pilot car companies for your city.

packages.name: Nationwide Sponsor
packages.description: Your ad on every page of the site, in the Nationwide Sponsors section under each page's title.
